question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A place where coins are made
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. Mint.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "**mint**" refers to a place where coins are produced under government authority.(टकसाल) 

 
 
• **Example: **The United States Mint produces coins for the nation to conduct its trade and commerce.
 
 
 
• The correct word "**Mint**" signifies a facility where coins, medals, and sometimes paper currency are manufactured. 
 
 
• **Example: **The Royal Mint in the United Kingdom is famous for producing coins and medals of exceptional quality.
 
 

Therefore, the **correct answer **is- **Mint**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Trough**: This is a long, narrow open container for animals to eat or drink out of.(गर्त)
 
• **Post Office**: A public department or corporation responsible for mail services and (in some countries) telecommunications.(डाक-घर)
 
• **Grove**: A small wood, orchard, or group of trees.(कुंज)
